class Promise {
    private $resolver;
    public function __construct(callable $executor) {
        $this->resolver = function() {};
        $executor($this->resolver);
    }
    public function then(callable $callback) {
        return $callback();
    }
}

function For($a, $b, $fn) {
    if ($a < $b) {
        for ($i = $a; $i <= $b; $i++) {
            $res = $fn($i);
            if ($res !== null) return $res;
        }
    } else {
        for ($i = $a; $i >= $b; $i--) {
            $res = $fn($i);
            if ($res !== null) return $res;
        }
    }
}

function Arr($a, $b, $fn, $prev = 0) {
    $p = $prev;
    if ($a < $b) {
        $result = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i <= $b - $a; $i++) {
            $val = $a + $i;
            if ($fn) {
                $p = $fn($val, $p);
                $result[] = $p;
            } else {
                $result[] = $val;
            }
        }
        return $result;
    } else {
        $result = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i <= $a - $b; $i++) {
            $val = $a - $i;
            if ($fn) {
                $p = $fn($val, $p);
                $result[] = $p;
            } else {
                $result[] = $val;
            }
        }
        return $result;
    }
}

// Add methods to arrays and objects via helper functions since PHP doesn't support prototype extension directly

function array_sum_with_fn($arr, $fn = null) {
    $sum = 0;
    foreach ($arr as $v) {
        $sum += $fn ? $fn($v) : $v;
    }
    return $sum;
}

function array_uniq_with_fn($arr, $fn = null) {
    $seen = [];
    $result = [];
    foreach ($arr as $v) {
        $key = $fn ? $fn($v) : $v;
        if (!isset($seen[$key])) {
            $seen[$key] = true;
            $result[] = $v;
        }
    }
    return $result;
}

function array_to_obj_with_fn($arr, $fn) {
    $obj = [];
    foreach ($arr as $v) {
        $pair = $fn($v);
        $obj[$pair[0]] = $pair[1];
    }
    return $obj;
}

function array_min_with_fn($arr, $fn = null) {
    if (empty($arr)) return [null, -1, null];
    $minVal = null;
    $minIndex = -1;
    foreach ($arr as $i => $v) {
        $val = $fn ? $fn($v, $i) : $v;
        if ($minVal === null || $val < $minVal) {
            $minVal = $val;
            $minIndex = $i;
        }
    }
    return [$arr[$minIndex], $minIndex, $minVal];
}

function array_max_with_fn($arr, $fn = null) {
    if (empty($arr)) return [null, -1, null];
    $maxVal = null;
    $maxIndex = -1;
    foreach ($arr as $i => $v) {
        $val = $fn ? $fn($v, $i) : $v;
        if ($maxVal === null || $val > $maxVal) {
            $maxVal = $val;
            $maxIndex = $i;
        }
    }
    return [$arr[$maxIndex], $maxIndex, $maxVal];
}

function gcd($a, $b) {
    if ($b == 0) return $a;
    return gcd($b, $a % $b);
}

function mod_pow($a, $n, $m) {
    if ($n == 0) return 1;
    if ($n % 2 == 0) {
        return mod_pow(($a * $a) % $m, intdiv($n, 2), $m);
    }
    return ($a * mod_pow($a, $n - 1, $m)) % $m;

    if ($b == 0) return [1, 0];
    else {
        list($x, $y) = extendedEuclid($b, $a % $b);
        return [$y, $x - intdiv($a, $b) * $y];

}

source_data.prob_desc_description: You are given two strings $$$s$$$ and $$$t$$$ consisting of lowercase Latin letters. The length of $$$t$$$ is $$$2$$$ (i.e. this string consists only of two characters).In one move, you can choose any character of $$$s$$$ and replace it with any lowercase Latin letter. More formally, you choose some $$$i$$$ and replace $$$s_i$$$ (the character at the position $$$i$$$) with some character from 'a' to 'z'.You want to do no more than $$$k$$$ replacements in such a way that maximizes the number of occurrences of $$$t$$$ in $$$s$$$ as a subsequence.Recall that a subsequence is a sequence that can be derived from the given sequence by deleting zero or more elements without changing the order of the remaining elements.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print one integer — the maximum possible number of occurrences of $$$t$$$ in $$$s$$$ as a subsequence if you replace no more than $$$k$$$ characters in $$$s$$$ optimally.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line of the input contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 200$$$; $$$0 \le k \le n$$$) — the length of $$$s$$$ and the maximum number of moves you can make. The second line of the input contains the string $$$s$$$ consisting of $$$n$$$ lowercase Latin letters. The third line of the input contains the string $$$t$$$ consisting of two lowercase Latin letters.
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first example, you can obtain the string "abab" replacing $$$s_1$$$ with 'a' and $$$s_4$$$ with 'b'.
